title: How Much of You Is Water, and Why It Matters
post_title: How Much of You Is Water, and Why It Matters | QuantaTale
post_description: How much of the human body is water and what that water does, from the USGS and the NIH. Sources: United States Geological Survey https://www.usgs.gov/water-science-school/science/water-you-water-and-human-body and National Institutes of Health https://newsinhealth.nih.gov/2023/05/hydrating-health #Science #ScienceFacts #QuantaTale
narration: How much of your body is actually water? For an adult, a large share of the body is water. Your brain, heart and lungs hold an even bigger share than that. Even your bones are partly water. Babies are born with more water than adults have. Every one of your cells needs water to work. Water also carries waste material out of the body. Sweating, using the bathroom and even breathing out all cost your body water, so you have to drink to replace it.
